cases.scenario: Shared URL contains redirects, credentials, alternate host syntax or an unsupported source
cases.acceptance: Canonicalize safely; reject unsafe targets; select only an enabled adapter; no arbitrary backend fetch.

cases.scenario: Spotify reference yields a probable YouTube recording with a different edit/duration
cases.acceptance: Show both identities and ambiguity; require recording choice; do not inherit old sample cues or label it a Spotify master.

cases.scenario: Enabled extractor receives an eligible, known fixture
cases.acceptance: Complete resolve, format selection, transfer, validation and library publication; actual bytes/source match expected evidence.

cases.scenario: Named website has a working form but no verified integration contract
cases.acceptance: Mark vendor integration unverified; do not advertise an embedded API or silently scrape the form as a production dependency.

cases.scenario: Lossy source is converted to high-bitrate MP3, WAV or FLAC
cases.acceptance: Preserve original and processing history; show output format without claiming recovered fidelity or lossless source.

cases.scenario: Server returns HTML, executable bytes, corrupt/truncated media or excessive size
cases.acceptance: Fail safely before playable publication; maintain bounded resource use and actionable diagnostics.

cases.scenario: Transfer resumes after URL expiry or changed object
cases.acceptance: Re-resolve and validate identity/range; resume only the same object; otherwise restart or report change.

cases.scenario: Cancellation races transfer, conversion or publication
cases.acceptance: Old revision cannot publish after cancellation wins; completed publication reports already completed; unrelated playback continues.

cases.scenario: Process exits between file placement and database commit
cases.acceptance: Recovery reconciles the manifest once; no false-ready record, duplicate asset or deletion of referenced media.

cases.scenario: Duplicate request or retry arrives
cases.acceptance: Same immutable request reuses the job; changed payload with reused key is rejected; one worker owns each revision.

cases.scenario: Selected playlist contains duplicates, unavailable items and reordered completion
cases.acceptance: Preserve selected order and intentional duplicates; report per-item outcomes and partial completion honestly.

cases.scenario: Acquisition and conversion compete with the selected live workload
cases.acceptance: Meet the relevant audio/thermal gate or defer acquisition work; no network/file/model work in the callback.

cases.scenario: Adapter receives rate limit, login requirement, access denial or repeated failure
cases.acceptance: Use bounded retry/backoff or specific blocked state; no credential harvesting, control bypass or infinite retry.

cases.scenario: Malicious URL, filename, metadata or media parser input reaches a worker
cases.acceptance: No shell/path injection, private-network fetch, secret access or unbounded decode; failures stay isolated.

cases.scenario: Technical success conflicts with service, content-use or distribution evidence
cases.acceptance: Preserve independent statuses and specific reason; never present technical success as an authorization decision.

cases.scenario: Extractor update breaks formats or matches
cases.acceptance: Pin and canary the update, disable/rollback the affected adapter, preserve downloaded library and live engine.

cases.scenario: ParDay receives restricted metadata or sensitive delivery URL
cases.acceptance: Exclude restricted fields/secrets from prompts, embeddings and logs; permitted job state remains useful.

cases.scenario: Download finishes after the user changes decks or takes manual control
cases.acceptance: Publish to library only; any subsequent load/armed plan needs current state and its own authority.

cases.scenario: User cancels in-app versus presses Android Task Manager Stop
cases.acceptance: In-app cancellation targets acquisition; OS app termination is reported as interruption and recovery is tested without promising continuous audio.

cases.scenario: S26 Ultra is tested across software build, storage/network and audio routes
cases.acceptance: Record exact profile and outcomes; no universal device/source certification from a model name alone.
